book: Quantitative Aptitude for Competitive Examinations — R.S. Aggarwal

questions.question: In which year was the difference between the appeared candidates and qualified candidates the second lowest across all zones?
questions.explanation: Calculate (Appeared - Qualified) for each year across all zones. 2007 yields the second lowest difference.

questions.question: The number of candidates who qualified the test from zone R in the year 2010 was approximately what percentage of the number of candidates who appeared from zone Q in the year 2008 ?
questions.explanation: Percentage = (Qualified from R in 2010 / Appeared from Q in 2008) × 100 ≈ 137%.

questions.question: What was the average number of candidates appeared from zone T over all the years together ?
questions.explanation: Average = Sum of candidates appeared from zone T / Total number of years = 805.

questions.question: What was the ratio of the number of candidates appeared from zone P in the year 2005 to the number of candidates qualified from zone S in the year 2007 ?
questions.explanation: Ratio = (Appeared from P in 2005) : (Qualified from S in 2007) = 4 : 7.

questions.question: From which zone was the total number of candidates who qualified the test, the second highest overall?
questions.explanation: Summing qualified candidates per zone over all years reveals zone T as second highest.

questions.question: What was the approximate percent increase in the semester fees of B.Ed course in the year 2007 as compared to the previous year ?
What was the average semester fee charged for M.Sc. course over all the years together ?
questions.explanation: Sum of M.Sc fees = 5.8 + 6.4 + 10.2 + 14.6 + 17.7 + 20.9 = 75.6 (in thousands). Average = 75.6 / 6 = 12.6 thousand = ₹ 12600.

questions.question: What was the difference between the total semester fee charged for Diploma course over the years together and the fee charged for B.Tech Course in the year 2009 ?
questions.explanation: Total Diploma fee = 1.8 + 3.2 + 4.8 + 5.6 + 12.5 + 14.9 = 42.8 thousand. B.Tech in 2009 = 35.8 thousand. Diff = 42.8 - 35.8 = 7.0 thousand = ₹ 7000.

questions.question: The semester fee charged for M.Phil course in the year 2008 was approximately what percentage of the semester fee charged for M.Sc course in the year 2009 ?
What was the total semester fee charged for all the courses together in the year 2006 ?
What is the ratio of the total number of candidates clearing the entrance examination from State B in the year 2004 to that of those clearing the entrance examination from State C in the same year ?
In which year did the highest number of candidates clear the entrance exam from State D ?
questions.explanation: In 2009: 2.01 × 56% = 1.1256 lakh, which is the highest for State D.

questions.question: What is the number of candidates not clearing the entrance exam from State A in the year 2007 ?
What is the total number of candidates clearing the entrance examination from States E and F together in the year 2006 ?
What is the average number of candidates appearing for the entrance exam from State D in the years 2007, 2008 and 2009 together ?
What is the ratio of the number of candidates failing the exam from City D to that of those failing the exam from City A ?
The number of candidates appearing for the exam from City C is what percent of the number of candidates appearing for the exam from City B ? (rounded off to nearest integer)
The number of candidates passing the examination from City F is what percent of the total number of candidates appearing from all the cities together ? (rounded off to two digits after the decimal)
Which city has the highest number of students failing the entrance exam ?
questions.explanation: City D failing count = 2.27 × (3/4) = 1.7025 lakh, which is the highest among all cities.

questions.question: What is the number of candidates passing the exam from City E ?
What is the respective ratio of the number of females in Production department to the number of females in the Marketing department ?
questions.explanation: Females in Production = 900 × 23% = 207. Females in Marketing = 450 × 44% = 198. Ratio = 207 : 198 = 23 : 22.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the number of females in the HR and Accounts departments together to the number of males in the same departments together?
What is the total number of employees in all the departments together?
The total number of employees in the HR department forms approximately what percent of the total number of employees in the Accounts department?
What is the total number of males in the IT and Customer Service departments together?
questions.explanation: Males IT = 840 × 55% = 462. Males Customer Service = 540 × 60% = 324. Total = 462 + 324 = 786 (None of these).

key_explanation_from_book.tabulation: Tabulation presents data in a table so that information can be compared and questions can be answered systematically.
key_explanation_from_book.rows: The horizontal lines in a table are called rows.
key_explanation_from_book.columns: The vertical lines in a table are called columns.
key_explanation_from_book.captions: The distinctive heads of the rows/columns are known as captions.
